summary: Defines DHCPv6 options for passing a list of available recursive DNS name servers and a domain search list to a client. This lets a host learn which servers to ask for name lookups, without manual setup. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: A new computer needs to know whom to ask for directions to a website. This lets the network hand it a short list of helpers, so it does not have to be told by hand.

questions: how does dhcpv6 provide dns servers
